_about: Agreement between raters or methods (R/agreement.R, data_type ratings). Biodes: analysis.agreement = {raters: [columns] or rater_column + score_column + unit_column, scale: nominal | ordinal | continuous, levels: [lowest .. highest]}.
_note_ordinal_primary: weighted kappa reported as primary for ordinal ratings: linear (Cicchetti-Allison, vcd Equal-Spacing); quadratic (Fleiss-Cohen) also reported.

icc_forms.ICC2: two-way random, absolute agreement, single rater
icc_forms.ICC1k: one-way random, mean of k raters
icc_forms.ICC2k: two-way random, absolute agreement, mean of k raters
icc_forms.ICC3k: two-way mixed, consistency, mean of k raters

_note_icc_primary: ICC2 (two-way, absolute agreement, single rater) is the usual choice when the same raters score every unit and any of them could score alone; ICC2k when the reported value is the raters' mean.

icc_scale.source: Koo & Li 2016, applied to the lower 95% bound

reference: Cohen 1960 Educ Psychol Meas 20:37; Cohen 1968 Psychol Bull 70:213; Fleiss 1971 Psychol Bull 76:378; Shrout & Fleiss 1979 Psychol Bull 86:420; Landis & Koch 1977 Biometrics 33:159; Koo & Li 2016 J Chiropr Med 15:155; Meyer et al. vcd (CRAN); Revelle psych (CRAN)
